name: @pipeworx/mcp-duration

tools.name: parse_duration
tools.description: Parse an ISO 8601 duration string (e.g. "PT1H30M", "P1Y2M10DT2H") into its components and an approximate total in seconds (keyless, offline). Note: months=30d, years=365d for the estimate.

tools.name: format_duration
tools.description: Convert a number of seconds into an ISO 8601 duration string and a human-readable form (keyless, offline).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-duration forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the duration pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
